content.comment_body: I'm experiencing an issue where my [product_name] expansion modules are not entering RUN mode. I have a [product_name] basic module and another expansion module, and I'm trying to connect two [product_name] modules with a 12/24V DC power supply. All modules are connected to power, but the [product_name] modules fail to go into RUN mode. Any ideas why this could be happening? Thank you for your time.
Hello [user_name], Do you power on the expansion modules first and then the basic module, or the other way around? Best regards,

Hello [user_name], To properly connect the [product_name] expansion module to the basic module, please make sure of the following: * Use a separate power supply * Ensure the power supply is turned on at the same time as, or before, the basic module * Confirm the physical connection to the basic module is secure Regards, [user_name]
Thank you all. The issue is resolved. The problem was that the power supply was switched on to the basic module before the [product_name] expansion modules. Have a good day.
Hi [user_name], Glad to hear it's resolved. Good luck!

analysis.insight_summary: Users faced a challenge where [product_name] expansion modules did not enter RUN mode when connected with a [product_name] basic module and other expansions. The root cause was the order in which the power supply was activated, with the expansion modules requiring power simultaneously with or prior to the basic module.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] expansion modules to transition to RUN mode properly when powered together with other connected modules.
